subject: Request: matching credits for upcoming RFP bake-off
messages:
From: Elliot Sandoval <elliot@protonhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: RFP bake-off: request for matching credits and short trial extension

Sergio / team —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're running an RFP next month (finals in mid-July) and Redwood is one of three vendors under consideration. The technical team liked the latency profile in the sandbox, but procurement is requesting a fair trial window and some promotional credits so we can do a head-to-head bake-off that mirrors our production traffic.

Specifically, two asks:
- Matching credit allocation roughly equivalent to what our other vendor is offering (~$10k in usage credits).
- A 30-day trial extension with a pinned model snapshot for the evaluation period so results are comparable.

Can you confirm what's possible and any internal approvals required? I'll need this formalized to move the RFP forward — we have a short mutual action plan deadline of 2026-07-15.

Attaching our eval checklist for context (small file).

Appreciate it,
Elliot Sandoval
Director, AI Infrastructure
Proton Health

[attachment: eval-checklist.xlsx]
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Sandoval <elliot@protonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off: request for matching credits and short trial extension

Elliot —

Thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the checklist. We want to make this as apples-to-apples as possible. On the credit side, we can provision a promotional credit pool and a timebox for the bake-off, but I need to confirm the exact amount with finance and get a quick OK from our programs team.

Preliminary proposal:
- 30-day trial extension starting on activation date
- $8k of promotional credits up-front, with the option to escalate to $12k if the bake-off moves to a paid pilot within 30 days after results
- A pinned model snapshot and reproducible eval config (we'll provide the redwood-eval-config.yaml)

Next steps from our side:
1) I'll draft a mutual action plan (MAP) and circulate for signatures (attached).
2) Ben — can you confirm promotional credit banding and whether we can pre-authorize the escalation?
3) Marissa — once we confirm, can you prepare a formal quote/term sheet so procurement has something to sign?

Elliot, if that sounds workable I can escalate for quick approval today.

Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0122

[attachment: MAP_ProtonHealth_Redwood_Draft.pdf]
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Elliot Sandoval <elliot@protonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off: request for matching credits and short trial extension

Sergio / team —

We can approve the initial promo package: authorize $8,000 in trial credits for the bake-off. Conditions:
- Credits expire 30 days after activation.
- If Proton Health signs a pilot or contract within 30 days of the bake-off completion, we can top up to $12,000 (one-time escalation).
- SOC2 summary and runtime isolation notes required for procurement review (we'll attach SOC2-summary.pdf).

Operational asks for Proton: please provide:
- Expected token volume over the 30-day window (ballpark)
- The eval script and traffic profile to reproduce during the bake-off (so we can pin exact seq lengths and batching parameters)

Sergio — I recommend we mark this as approved and have Marissa generate the official quote / MAP with the conditions above. I'll flag finance if they need to sign the escalation clause.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

[attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf]
From: Elliot Sandoval <elliot@protonhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off: request for matching credits and short trial extension

Thanks — that structure should work. A few clarifications from procurement and infra: 

- Proton can commit to a realistic token estimate: ~18M tokens over 30 days for the test workload.
- We'll need the eval script and redwood-eval-config.yaml so our infra team can run the same traffic shape against both vendors. Can you attach it?
- Procurement would like the activation window to start no later than 2026-07-01 and run through 2026-07-30.

If you can get the MAP and a formal quote over today/tomorrow, we can prioritize the validation and lock the bake-off schedule.

Elliot

Elliot —

We have formal approval for the package Ben outlined. Attached is the official MAP and a quote that includes the $8k promotional credit and the conditional $4k top-up on contract conversion. Key points for procurement: 

- Activation window: 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-30 (as requested).
